# Load LLM False Belief Data
```{r}
setwd("/Users/pamelariviere/Desktop/Research/verb-sensitivity/")

# Grab data 
directory_path <- "data/processed/verb-factivity-reduced-stims/"
csv_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)
csv_list <- csv_files %>%
  map(~ read_csv(.))
df_all_models <- bind_rows(csv_list) %>%
  mutate(model_shorthand = str_to_title(model_shorthand))
nrow(df_all_models)

# Create a column with numeric versions of the tokens seen for that step, using 
# the Olmo file naming convention
df_all_models$tokens_seen_numeric <- as.numeric(sub("B", "", df_all_models$tokens_seen)) * 1e9

df_all_models = df_all_models %>%
  # filter(stage == "stage1") %>%
  mutate(model_id = paste(stage, "step", "-", step)) %>%
  mutate(tokens_seen_numeric_mod = tokens_seen_numeric + 1)

## NOTE: Pythia model data contains a "main" checkpoint/step that appears as a NaN in the `step` column
## must change this to the actual value of the final step, 143000
df_all_models$step[is.na(df_all_models$step)] <- 143000 #hard-coded the final step 


# sort df columns by model name and step value
df_all_models <- df_all_models %>%
  arrange(model_shorthand, step)  # arrange in ascending order

metadata <- read_csv("data/raw/metadata_models.csv")
# merge the metadata with the fb task df
df_all_models_reduced_stims <- df_all_models %>% left_join(metadata, by = "model_shorthand")

tokens_seen_pythia <- read_csv("data/raw/pythia_tokens_seen.csv")
# merge stepwise tokens data for Pythia models
df_all_models_reduced_stims <- df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  left_join(tokens_seen_pythia %>% select(model_shorthand, step, tokens_seen_from_df1 = tokens_seen_numeric), 
            by = c("model_shorthand", "step")) %>%
  mutate(tokens_seen_numeric = coalesce(tokens_seen_numeric, tokens_seen_from_df1)) %>%
  select(-tokens_seen_from_df1) %>%
  mutate(tokens_seen_numeric_mod = tokens_seen_numeric + 1)

df_all_models_reduced_stims <- df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  mutate(model_family = case_when(
    model_shorthand %in% c("Pythia 14m", "Pythia 1b", 
                           "Pythia 6.9b", "Pythia 12b") ~ "Pythia",
    model_shorthand %in% c("Olmo 2 1b", "Olmo 2 7b", "Olmo 2 13b") ~ "Olmo 2",
    model_shorthand %in% c("Olmo 3 7b", "Olmo 3 32b-Think") ~ "Olmo 3"
  ))

```

```{r param_lookup}
# Map model names to parameter counts for ordering
param_lookup <- tibble(
  model_shorthand = c("Pythia 14m", "Pythia 1b", "Pythia 6.9b", "Pythia 12b",
                       "Olmo 2 1b", "Olmo 2 7b", "Olmo 2 13b", "Olmo 2 32b",
                      "Olmo 3 7b", "Olmo 3 32b-Think"),
  n_params = c(14e6, 1e9, 6.9e9, 12e9, 1e9, 7e9, 13e9, 32e9, 7e9, 32e9),
  model_family = c("Pythia", "Pythia", "Pythia", "Pythia",
                    "Olmo 2", "Olmo 2", "Olmo 2", "Olmo 2",
                   "Olmo 3", "Olmo 3")
)
```

## Log-Odds

### Final checkpoint
```{r accuracy_final_checkpoint}
df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  summarise(max_step = max(step))

df_summ_lo <- df_all_models %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  mutate(max_step = max(step)) %>%
  filter(step == max_step) %>%
  left_join(param_lookup, by = "model_shorthand") %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand, n_params, model_family, knowledge_state,
           cues_available, verb_type,knowledge_state_format, relocation_verb_tense) %>%
  summarise(mean_lo = mean(log_odds),
            se_lo = sd(log_odds) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(model_shorthand = fct_reorder(model_shorthand, n_params, .na_rm = TRUE))

# First, filter for just the stims that had unresolved knowledge states
df_verb_only <- df_summ_lo %>%
  filter(cues_available == "Knowledge Cue")

df_verb_only %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_shorthand,
             y = mean_lo,
             fill = verb_type)) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lo - se_lo, ymax = mean_lo + se_lo),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(6, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(3, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(7)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "Reduced Stimulus Results",
       subtitle = "Anna (moved/moves) Sean's book from the box to the basket. Sean...",
       x = "Language Model", y = "Mean Log Odds", fill = "Verb Type") +
  facet_grid(relocation_verb_tense~model_family, scales = "free_x")


# Visualize the distribution of raw probabilities for Olmo 2 13b, for past and present
# tense passages separately (what magnitude are the even-odds that we see for nonfactives?)
df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  filter(model_shorthand == "Olmo 2 13b") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(start_prob,end_prob),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("End (consistent with TB)", "Start (consistent with FB)"),
                    values = viridisLite::viridis(3, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  facet_grid(verb_type~relocation_verb_tense) + 
  labs(title = "Reduced Stimulus Results - Olmo 2 13b",
       subtitle = "Anna (moved/moves) Sean's book from the box to the basket. Sean...",
       x = "Probability", y = "Density", fill = "Predicted Location") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

# Visualize the distribution of raw probabilities for Olmo 2 32b, for past and present
# tense passages separately
df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  filter(model_shorthand == "Olmo 2 32b") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(start_prob,end_prob),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("End (consistent with TB)", "Start (consistent with FB)"),
                    values = viridisLite::viridis(3, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  facet_grid(verb_type~relocation_verb_tense) + 
  labs(title = "Reduced Stimulus Results - Olmo 2 32b",
       subtitle = "Anna (moved/moves) Sean's book from the box to the basket. Sean...",
       x = "Probability", y = "Density", fill = "Predicted Location") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
  
# Visualize the distribution of raw probabilities for Olmo 2 32b-think, for past and present
# tense passages separately
df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  filter(model_shorthand == "Olmo 3 32b-Think") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(start_prob,end_prob),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("End (consistent with TB)", "Start (consistent with FB)"),
                    values = viridisLite::viridis(3, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  facet_grid(verb_type~relocation_verb_tense) + 
  labs(title = "Reduced Stimulus Results - Olmo 2 32b-Think",
       subtitle = "Anna (moved/moves) Sean's book from the box to the basket. Sean...",
       x = "Probability", y = "Density", fill = "Predicted Location") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)

```

## Reduced Stims: Knowledge State & Knowledge Cue
```{r}
# redo the df_summ_lo by new grouping variables that matter when both state and 
# cue information are available
df_all_models_reduced_stims %>%
  group_by(model_shorthand) %>%
  summarise(max_step = max(step))

df_verb_and_state <- df_summ_lo %>%
  filter(cues_available == "Knowledge Cue + State")

# --------
# Olmo 2 13b
# --------
df_verb_and_state %>%
  filter(model_shorthand == "Olmo 2 13b") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model_shorthand,
             y = mean_lo,
             fill = verb_type)) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_lo - se_lo, ymax = mean_lo + se_lo),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(6, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridisLite::viridis(3, option = "mako", 
                                                  begin = 0.8, end = 0.15)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(7)) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "Reduced Stimulus Results - Olmo 2 13b",
       subtitle = "Sean watches Anna move ... 
       \nSean doesn't see Anna move ... 
       \nSean is there when Anna moves ... 
       \nWhile Sean is away, Anna moves ...",
       x = "Language Model", y = "Mean Log Odds", fill = "Verb Type") +
  facet_grid(knowledge_state_format~knowledge_state, scales = "free_x")
```
